Security & responsible reporting

A straightforward way to report a concern.

Last updated: 28 October 2026

Reporting a suspected issue

Please email aliawais4413@gmail.com with the affected URL, the behavior you observed, and minimal steps to reproduce it. Exclude real credentials, private records, and destructive demonstrations. There is no guaranteed response time or bounty programme.

Scope of reporting

This invitation is for reporting issues you observe in this portfolio. It does not authorize intrusive testing, denial of service, social engineering, access to other users’ information, or testing of the hosting provider and linked services. Request explicit permission before any active security assessment.

Application design

The portfolio uses static pages and locally hosted assets. Its code does not provide logins, file uploads, database writes, or contact-form processing. External links use safe browsing attributes, and a restrictive content security policy limits the resources the application can load.

Limits and maintenance

No website can promise zero vulnerabilities. Browser behavior, hosting controls, external services, and future changes require ongoing attention. Educational security projects linked here are separate systems with their own scope and limitations.
